name: fix78_party_snoop
verifies: fix-78 (owner: Gorn, Diego and Milten shouted 'WhyAreYouInHere' while the hero searched a house in Ardea): the hero's friends never call out at him in a house - neither at their Ardea spot (friend-type, not in the party: CP AssessPlayerZone -> ZS_ObserveSuspect, which is silent) nor as party members (CP AssessPlayerZone / AssessWarn / theft skip the hero's party); in Faring the house's owner (Mitch) still warns the intruder and the friends stay quiet
steps: # A. Ardea at the start: the four friends stand at Ardea_4Friends, not in the party, nobody else around
# B. the same as party members, right next to the hero
party Gorn add; party Diego add; party Milten add
bring Gorn dist=1.5; bring Diego dist=2; bring Milten dist=2.5
# C. Faring, a house of Enclave security with its owner present (Mitch, a Faring guard)
bring Gorn dist=1.5; bring Diego dist=2; bring Milten dist=2.5
party Gorn remove; party Diego remove; party Milten remove
notes: fix-188: the Mitch wait is soft (never passed, b1019..1022b): 'safe' gives Orc fame 80, so the Faring house welcomes the hero (no GetLost), and the resident's WhyAreYouInHere (ZS_ObserveZonePlayer after ZS_GotoPlayerZone) is not modelled (CrimeSystem.ObserveLine) - Mitch has nothing to say; the step checks the friends' silence next to a present owner. Probes calls:X (perception lines X said to the hero, NpcReactionView) and warning:X (ZS_ReactToZone/Weapon step) were added by fix-78. Before fix-78 step A failed: the friend-type friends observed the hero in Ardea's Public houses and every observer said 'WhyAreYouInHere' (in G3 only ZS_ObserveZonePlayer, the resident that walked up, says it). In C the friends may defend the hero against Mitch (PlayerCommand) - that is G3; they must never take the hero as their target.
